classes.name: index
classes.reason: In _consume the read is aborted once 'probe.NS() - started > budget_ns', a budget broadcast from producer 0's write time, and while the single per-file read happens every producer/idle rank is already parked at the trailing barrier.wait(), so the whole job stalls on that one deadline-bound read per file per unit.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report re-reads each class_b file CLASS_B_READS(=8) times in a plain loop with no time check, and since it only runs on the consumer after _consume while all other ranks already wait at the trailing barrier.wait(), each of those 8 reads blocks the entire job until it finishes.
